2026-09-28 12:36:24.074009 | controller |
2026-09-28 12:36:24.074013 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-28 12:36:24.074018 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-28 12:36:24.074021 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-28 12:36:24.074024 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-28 12:36:24.074027 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-28 12:36:24.074034 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
